source.label: Elvira and the Party Monsters rules and strategy

supportingSources.label: Bally Elvira and the Party Monsters operations manual

strategy.overview: Three locks are lit at the start of the game. Shoot the Skull Lock three times to begin three-ball Multiball; later, complete B-A-T or J-A-M to relight locks. During Multiball, make both the left Monster Slide and right Party Punch ramps to light the Jackpot, then return to its flashing ramp.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot the Skull Lock three times to start three-ball Multiball. After the first Multiball, complete B-A-T or J-A-M to relight the needed locks. During Multiball, shoot both the left Monster Slide and right Party Punch ramps, then shoot the flashing ramp for the Jackpot.
strategy.summary: Shoot the Skull Lock three times for three-ball Multiball. Relight later locks with B-A-T or J-A-M. During Multiball, shoot both ramps, then return to the flashing ramp for the Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the Skull Lock three times; all three locks are lit at game start.

quickInfo.name: Relight Locks
quickInfo.summary: After the first Multiball, complete B-A-T or J-A-M.

quickInfo.name: Light Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, shoot both the Monster Slide and Party Punch ramps.

quickInfo.name: Collect Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the ramp whose Jackpot arrow is flashing.

steps.text: Shoot the Skull Lock three times to start three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, shoot the left Monster Slide ramp and the right Party Punch ramp.
After both ramps are made, shoot the ramp with the flashing Jackpot arrow to collect.
For later Multiballs, complete B-A-T or J-A-M to relight the required Skull locks, then collect them at the Skull.

alternatives.title: Build the Monster Slide
alternatives.when: Use this when the left ramp is returning cleanly.

steps.text: Complete B-A-T or J-A-M to light the Monster Slide for an E-L-V-I-R-A letter.
Make the left ramp four times in a row to light one million, then make it again to collect.
Keep repeating the ramp to spell E-L-V-I-R-A, then shoot the Skull for the timed three-million award.
Build Barbecue Bonus, Boogie Bonus, and the Million or Hold Bonus inserts through their related playfield features.
Shoot the center eject when the desired award is lit.
Return to the safer ramp route after the eject instead of forcing a Skull shot from an uncontrolled feed.

machineSetup: Confirm lock sharing, Jackpot carryover, Extra Ball, and Special settings before competitive play.
Test the Skull Lock, B-A-T rollovers, J-A-M drops, both ramps, center eject, kickouts, and lock releases.

cautions.issue: The first Multiball begins with all locks lit, but later Multiballs require lock relights.
cautions.response: After the first Multiball, complete B-A-T or J-A-M before returning to the Skull for each needed lock.
